jobs.title: Real Estate Business Developer
jobs.description: Decathlon Philippines is committed to a strategic, multi-year expansion initiative to better serve our customers across the region! To accompany this fast development, we are looking for a Real Estate Business Developer to develop, execute and manage business development projects leading to a profitable and sustainable growth for Decathlon within a dedicated zone/region. Key Responsibilities 1. Develop Local Expansion Strategy Define the vision and strategy for Decathlon's development (including stores and other formats) within the territory to increase market share. This includes: Analyzing market data (traffic, sales performance, competition, etc.). Designing the multi-channel network and planning the implementation of new solutions (e.g., shops, lockers, digital points), ensuring alignment with the Country Project. 2. Lead Project Development & Execution Manage the full lifecycle of real estate projects, including new openings and relocations: Source, negotiate, and secure sites (purchases/leases). Execute projects: Prepare studies, validate technical/financial details, secure permits, coordinate legal aspects, and control the budget. Manage local relationships with administrative/political bodies, and proactively advise on and execute physical partnerships and new business initiatives. 3. Manage Real Estate Portfolio Oversee the optimization and performance of the existing real estate assets: Track the financial performance (revenue/costs vs. budget) during a project's first year. Identify and execute store optimization opportunities (e.g., downsizing, enlarging, efficiency improvements, or green building investments). Execute land commercialization actions (sales or commercialization of vacant premises), following Asset Manager guidelines. jobs.title: Art Director
jobs.description: Job Summary Art Directors at SlideGenius are responsible for intake, oversight, and creative leadership toward successful project outcomes. They possess exceptional attention to detail, strong written communication skills, and a deep passion for design principles. While their expertise spans overall design, their experience in creating PowerPoint presentations is unparalleled. Art Directors manage written client communications—providing clear, professional updates, feedback, and creative direction to ensure alignment with client goals. This position functions as a bridge between project management, design teams, and clients, ensuring projects are executed with precision, efficiency, and design excellence. Duties/Responsibilities: Art Direction Brainstorm, suggest, critique, and demonstrate design and layout concepts that exemplify SlideGenius design standards. Translate written or recorded client feedback into actionable design direction. Provide clear, concise written communication to align the design team with client needs, even when project requirements shift unexpectedly. Client Communication (Written Only) Draft professional, well-structured client communication that guides creative conversations and clarifies design direction. Lead creative discovery activities through written correspondence, early-stage briefs, reviewing recorded calls, and internal pre-design planning. Maintain consistent, timely communication with clients through project updates and written correspondence. Design Facilitation Conducts thorough quality control reviews of all designer outputs before client delivery, ensuring art direction is followed, brand standards are upheld, and client expectations are met. Guide and mentor designers to uphold high creative standards, ensure client satisfaction, and achieve optimal project outcomes. The position also requires strong public speaking skills, the ability to confidently address clients or stakeholders—even on short notice—and at least basic knowledge of research and analysis. The ideal candidate is committed to continuous learning, open to enrolling in all necessary studies, courses, training, and workshops, and willing to obtain and pass any additional licenses required in the future. Flexibility to work in both hybrid and full on-site arrangements is also required. Serve as the sales liaison for accreditation renewals and applications, ensuring all documentation is properly prepared and submitted. jobs.title: Technical Sales Representative
jobs.description: Job description Technical Sales Representatives are an integral part of the income generating shoulder of the Company. It is their job to develop a prospective client’s interest and in doing business with the company. The skill of a Sales Representative is measured not by the maintenance of existing business but by their ability to develop new clients and create new business. A Technical Sales Representative must be able to determine what drivers the client is implementing for a given product, e.g. is this product price driven or market driven. The ability to deliver effective product/supplier presentations is essential in securing business. Sales Representatives in general will spend 80% of their time traveling to and visiting prospective buyers and current clients whilst the other 20% is spent in-house in preparation for selling days. 1) Creates client-visit itinerary for the next week and submits this the Friday before to Sales Supervisor. 2) Sells raw materials carried both in stock or indent as applicable to his/her assigned accounts. 3) Visits clients, to monitor and service all needs of the customer, and thereby create and contribute to more sales. 4) Assists clients in product innovations to increase business and turnover. This is achieved by providing frequent updates from the Raw Material Industry. 5) Handles and addresses problems which may arise in the course of client’s transaction i.e. shipment delays, etc. 6) Assists the Credit & Collection Department in payment monitoring of assigned clients. 7) Provides creative ideas and suggestions for better sales productivity, client coverage, and time management. Performs other duties that may be assigned from time to time by the Sales Supervisor, Department Manager, or designate.
